scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir web typecheck && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.access:deploy: pnpm --dir infra run deploy && pnpm access:export
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm check:web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --dir infra test && vp test run
scripts.build: vp -C . build && cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run && pnpm --dir ingress run build && pnpm --dir ingress exec cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run
scripts.test:worker: vp -C . build --config test/worker/vite.config.ts && vp test run --config vitest.worker.config.ts && WEB_TEST_ACCESS=required vp test run --config vitest.worker.config.ts && pnpm --dir web exec playwright test --config playwright.worker.config.ts
